title: 3D character animation, painterly non-photorealistic rendering.
content:
3D character animation, painterly non-photorealistic rendering.
Naturalistic slender body proportions, realistic head-to-body ratio.
Skin shaded with strong subsurface scattering, soft matte finish, warm
deep brown skin tones with natural sheen. Hair modelled as sculpted
layered volumes with warm rim lighting. Diffuse hazy key light, wide
aperture, shallow focus, heavy bloom. Muted warm palette: ochre,
terracotta, dusty rose, cream. Soft low-contrast grade. NOT
photorealistic, NOT live action. Vertical 9:16 framing, faces held
large in frame.

CHARACTERS (locked, no drift):
TUNDE — Nigerian man, early 30s, short-cropped hair, small beard,
patterned short-sleeve shirt. Expressive, panics silently, terrible at
hiding his face.
AMAKA — Nigerian woman, late 20s, long braids pulled back, gold hoops,
a fitted top and wrapper. Calm, direct, enjoying his suffering slightly.

LOCATION: a warm Lagos apartment sitting room in the evening. A worn
sofa, a small centre table with a bowl of oranges, louvered windows with
soft amber light, a standing fan turning slowly, a wall clock.

COLOR 60:30:10 — 60% warm amber wall and wood / 30% dusty rose shadow /
10% accent of orange fruit and gold earrings.

0-5s: tight vertical medium shot. Tunde sits on the sofa eating, relaxed.
Amaka enters, sits down slowly beside him, folds her hands, and says
quietly: "Tunde. I need to tell you something."

5-10s: close-up on Tunde. He stops chewing. His eyes go still. Slow push
in on his face as the panic sets in behind a completely frozen
expression. He swallows. He does not blink.

10-15s: he sets his plate down with exaggerated care, turns to face her
fully, and says with false calm: "Okay. I'm listening." His leg is
bouncing. Cut to Amaka, taking her time, adjusting her earring.

15-20s: Amaka exhales and says: "I used your card yesterday." Whip-cut to
Tunde. His entire body deflates in relief, head dropping back, hands over
his face, laughing: "Ahh! Amaka! You scared me! Is that all?"

20-25s: he waves it off, picks his plate back up, still laughing. Amaka
watches him for a beat, then says flatly: "Four hundred and fifty
thousand."

25-30s: Tunde freezes mid-bite. Slow push-in on his face as the number
lands. Long silence. Fan turning. He slowly sets the plate down again,
stares straight ahead, and says quietly: "Bring back the first
problem." Hold on Amaka trying not to laugh. Cut to black.

CAMERA: vertical medium two-shot on the sofa, slow push-ins on Tunde's
face for both panic beats, whip-cut to his relief, static hold on the
final line.

AUDIO: evening ambience, standing fan turning, faint traffic and a
distant generator outside, cutlery on a plate, natural conversational
Nigerian-accented delivery with real pauses. Dead silence on both freeze
beats. No music.

FORBIDDEN: no photorealistic rendering, no oversized cartoon heads, no
design drift, no subtitles, no background music, no readable text or
logos, no harsh lighting.

es.content:
Animación de personaje en 3D, renderizado pictórico no fotorrealista.
Proporciones corporales esbeltas y naturalistas, relación cabeza-cuerpo realista.
Piel sombreada con fuerte subsurface scattering, acabado mate suave, tonos de piel marrón oscuro cálidos con brillo natural. Cabello modelado como volúmenes esculpidos en capas con iluminación de contorno cálida. Luz principal difusa y brumosa, apertura amplia, enfoque poco profundo, bloom intenso. Paleta cálida y apagada: ocre, terracota, rosa empolvado, crema. Gradación suave de bajo contraste. NO fotorrealista, NO live action. Encuadre vertical 9:16, rostros grandes en cuadro.

PERSONAJES (bloqueados, sin deriva):
TUNDE — hombre nigeriano, principios de los 30, cabello corto, barba pequeña, camisa de manga corta estampada. Expresivo, entra en pánico en silencio, pésimo para ocultar lo que siente.
AMAKA — mujer nigeriana, finales de los 20, largas trenzas recogidas hacia atrás, aros dorados, top ajustado y wrapper. Tranquila, directa, disfrutando un poco de su sufrimiento.

UBICACIÓN: una sala de estar de un apartamento cálido en Lagos, por la tarde-noche. Un sofá gastado, una pequeña mesa central con un cuenco de naranjas, ventanas de lamas con luz ámbar suave, un ventilador de pie girando lentamente, un reloj de pared.

COLOR 60:30:10 — 60% pared y madera en ámbar cálido / 30% sombra rosa empolvado / 10% acento de fruta naranja y pendientes dorados.

0-5s: plano medio vertical cerrado. Tunde está sentado en el sofá comiendo, relajado. Amaka entra, se sienta lentamente a su lado, cruza las manos y dice en voz baja: "Tunde. I need to tell you something."

5-10s: primer plano de Tunde. Deja de masticar. Sus ojos se quedan inmóviles. Slow push in on his face as the panic sets in behind a completely frozen expression. Traga saliva. No parpadea.

10-15s: deja el plato con exagerado cuidado, se gira para mirarla de frente y dice con falsa calma: "Okay. I'm listening." Su pierna rebota. Cut to Amaka, taking her time, adjusting her earring.

15-20s: Amaka exhala y dice: "I used your card yesterday." Whip-cut to Tunde. Todo su cuerpo se desinfla de alivio, la cabeza cae hacia atrás, manos sobre la cara, riéndose: "Ahh! Amaka! You scared me! Is that all?"

20-25s: lo despacha con la mano, vuelve a coger el plato, todavía riéndose. Amaka lo observa un momento y luego dice secamente: "Four hundred and fifty thousand."

25-30s: Tunde se queda congelado a mitad de bocado. Slow push-in on his face as the number lands. Long silence. Fan turning. Lentamente vuelve a dejar el plato, mira al frente y dice en voz baja: "Bring back the first problem." Hold on Amaka trying not to laugh. Cut to black.

CÁMARA: plano medio vertical de dos personas en el sofá, slow push-ins on Tunde's face for both panic beats, whip-cut to his relief, static hold on the final line.

AUDIO: ambiente de la tarde-noche, ventilador de pie girando, tráfico lejano tenue y un generador distante afuera, cubiertos sobre un plato, interpretación natural conversacional con acento nigeriano y pausas reales. Silencio absoluto en ambos momentos de congelación. Sin música.

PROHIBIDO: no renderizado fotorrealista, no cabezas de caricatura sobredimensionadas, no deriva de diseño, no subtítulos, no música de fondo, no texto legible ni logotipos, no iluminación dura.

fr.content:
Animation de personnage 3D, rendu pictural non photoréaliste.
Proportions corporelles élancées et naturalistes, ratio tête/corps réaliste.
Peau ombrée avec un fort subsurface scattering, fini mat et doux, tons de peau brun foncé chauds avec un éclat naturel. Cheveux modélisés comme des volumes sculptés et superposés avec un warm rim lighting. Key light diffuse et brumeuse, grande ouverture, faible profondeur de champ, fort bloom. Palette chaude et atténuée : ocre, terracotta, rose poudré, crème. Étalonnage doux à faible contraste. PAS photoréaliste, PAS live action. Cadre vertical 9:16, visages maintenus grands dans le cadre.

PERSONNAGES (verrouillés, sans dérive) :
TUNDE — homme nigérian, début trentaine, cheveux très courts, petite barbe, chemise à manches courtes à motifs. Expressif, panique en silence, incapable de cacher ses émotions.
AMAKA — femme nigériane, fin vingtaine, longues tresses tirées en arrière, créoles dorées, haut ajusté et wrapper. Calme, directe, appréciant légèrement sa souffrance.

LIEU : un salon d’appartement chaleureux à Lagos, en soirée. Un canapé usé, une petite table basse avec un bol d’oranges, des fenêtres à persiennes laissant entrer une douce lumière ambrée, un ventilateur sur pied tournant lentement, une horloge murale.

COULEUR 60:30:10 — 60 % mur et bois ambre chaud / 30 % ombre rose poudré / 10 % accent d’oranges et de boucles d’oreilles dorées.

0-5s : plan moyen vertical serré. Tunde est assis sur le canapé en train de manger, détendu. Amaka entre, s’assoit lentement à côté de lui, croise les mains et dit doucement : "Tunde. I need to tell you something."

5-10s : gros plan sur Tunde. Il arrête de mâcher. Son regard se fige. Lent push-in sur son visage tandis que la panique s’installe derrière une expression complètement figée. Il avale sa salive. Il ne cligne pas des yeux.

10-15s : il repose son assiette avec un soin exagéré, se tourne entièrement vers elle et dit avec un calme feint : "Okay. I'm listening." Sa jambe bouge nerveusement. Cut vers Amaka, qui prend son temps, ajustant sa boucle d’oreille.

15-20s : Amaka expire et dit : "I used your card yesterday." Whip-cut vers Tunde. Tout son corps s’affaisse de soulagement, la tête rejetée en arrière, les mains sur le visage, riant : "Ahh! Amaka! You scared me! Is that all?"

20-25s : il balaie ça d’un geste, reprend son assiette, toujours en riant. Amaka le regarde un instant, puis dit sèchement : "Four hundred and fifty thousand."

25-30s : Tunde se fige en plein milieu de sa bouchée. Lent push-in sur son visage au moment où le chiffre tombe. Long silence. Le ventilateur tourne. Il repose lentement l’assiette, fixe droit devant lui et dit doucement : "Bring back the first problem." Rester sur Amaka qui essaie de ne pas rire. Cut to black.

CAMÉRA : plan moyen vertical en deux-shot sur le canapé, lent push-in sur le visage de Tunde pour les deux moments de panique, whip-cut vers son soulagement, maintien statique sur la dernière réplique.

AUDIO : ambiance de soirée, ventilateur sur pied qui tourne, léger trafic et générateur lointain à l’extérieur, couverts sur une assiette, interprétation naturelle avec accent nigérian et vraies pauses. Silence total sur les deux moments de figement. Pas de musique.

INTERDIT : aucun rendu photoréaliste, aucune tête de dessin animé surdimensionnée, aucune dérive de design, aucun sous-titre, aucune musique de fond, aucun texte lisible ni logo, aucun éclairage dur.

--- CONTINUATION DU FIL ---

ja.content:
3Dキャラクターアニメーション、絵画的な非写実レンダリング。  
自然な細身の体型比率、リアルな頭身比。  
肌は強いサブサーフェス・スキャタリングで陰影をつけ、ソフトなマット仕上げ。温かみのある深いブラウンの肌色に自然な艶。髪は彫刻的なレイヤー状ボリュームとして造形し、暖色のリムライトを当てる。拡散した霞がかったキーライト、広い絞り、浅い被写界深度、強いブルーム。抑えた暖色パレット：黄土色、テラコッタ、くすんだローズ、クリーム。柔らかい低コントラストのグレーディング。写実的ではない、実写ではない。縦9:16フレーミング、顔は大きく画面内に収める。

CHARACTERS (locked, no drift):
TUNDE — Nigerian man, early 30s, short-cropped hair, small beard,
patterned short-sleeve shirt. Expressive, panics silently, terrible at
hiding his face.
AMAKA — Nigerian woman, late 20s, long braids pulled back, gold hoops,
a fitted top and wrapper. Calm, direct, enjoying his suffering slightly.

LOCATION: eveningの温かいラゴスのアパートの居間。使い込まれたソファ、小さなセンターテーブルの上のオレンジのボウル、柔らかな琥珀色の光が差し込むルーバー窓、ゆっくり回るスタンドファン、壁時計。

COLOR 60:30:10 — 60% warm amber wall and wood / 30% dusty rose shadow /
10% accent of orange fruit and gold earrings.

0-5s: 縦長のタイトなミディアムショット。Tundeはソファに座って食事をしており、くつろいでいる。Amakaが入ってきて、彼の横にゆっくり座り、手を組み、静かに言う: "Tunde. I need to tell you something."

5-10s: Tundeのクローズアップ。彼は咀嚼を止める。目が固まる。完全に凍りついた表情の裏でパニックが広がっていくように、ゆっくりと顔へ寄る。彼は飲み込む。まばたきしない。

10-15s: 彼は大げさなほど丁寧に皿を置き、彼女の方へ体を完全に向け、作り物の落ち着きで言う: "Okay. I'm listening." 足が小刻みに揺れている。Amakaへカット。彼女はゆっくりと、イヤリングを直している。

15-20s: Amakaは息を吐いて言う: "I used your card yesterday." Tundeへウィップカット。彼の全身から力が抜けて安堵し、頭が後ろに落ち、両手で顔を覆って笑う: "Ahh! Amaka! You scared me! Is that all?"

20-25s: 彼は気にしないふりをして手を振り、まだ笑いながら皿を持ち上げ直す。Amakaは一拍見つめ、それから平然と言う: "Four hundred and fifty thousand."

25-30s: Tundeは一口食べかけたまま固まる。数字が届いた瞬間の顔へ、ゆっくり寄る。長い沈黙。回るファン。彼はゆっくりと再び皿を置き、正面を見つめて、静かに言う: "Bring back the first problem." Amakaが笑いをこらえているところでホールド。ブラックアウト。

CAMERA: ソファ上の縦長ミディアムの2ショット、Tundeの2回のパニックの瞬間は顔へゆっくり寄る、安堵の場面はウィップカット、最後のセリフは静止ホールド。

AUDIO: evening ambience, standing fan turning, faint traffic and a distant generator outside, cutlery on a plate, natural conversational Nigerian-accented delivery with real pauses. Dead silence on both freeze beats. No music.

FORBIDDEN: no photorealistic rendering, no oversized cartoon heads, no design drift, no subtitles, no background music, no readable text or logos, no harsh lighting.

ko.content:
3D 캐릭터 애니메이션, 회화적인 비사실적 렌더링.
자연스러운 마른 체형 비율, 현실적인 머리-몸 비율.

pt.content:
Animação de personagem em 3D, renderização pictórica não fotorrealista.
Proporções corporais esguias e naturalistas, proporção cabeça-corpo realista.
Pele sombreada com forte subsurface scattering, acabamento fosco suave, tons de pele castanho-escuros quentes com brilho natural. Cabelo modelado como volumes esculpidos em camadas com iluminação de contorno quente. Luz principal difusa e enevoada, abertura ampla, foco raso, bloom intenso. Paleta quente e suave: ocre, terracota, rosa empoeirado, creme. Color grading suave e de baixo contraste. NÃO fotorrealista, NÃO live action. Enquadramento vertical 9:16, rostos grandes no quadro.

PERSONAGENS (travados, sem variação):
TUNDE — homem nigeriano, início dos 30 anos, cabelo curto, barba rala, camisa de manga curta estampada. Expressivo, entra em pânico em silêncio, péssimo em esconder o que sente no rosto.
AMAKA — mulher nigeriana, fim dos 20 anos, tranças longas puxadas para trás, argolas douradas, top ajustado e wrapper. Calma, direta, curtindo um pouco o sofrimento dele.

LOCAL: sala de estar de um apartamento em Lagos, à noite, com clima acolhedor. Um sofá gasto, uma mesinha de centro com uma tigela de laranjas, janelas de veneziana com luz âmbar suave, um ventilador de pé girando lentamente, um relógio de parede.

COR 60:30:10 — 60% parede e madeira em âmbar quente / 30% sombra rosa empoeirada / 10% destaque de frutas laranja e brincos dourados.

0-5s: plano médio vertical fechado. Tunde está sentado no sofá comendo, relaxado. Amaka entra, senta-se devagar ao lado dele, cruza as mãos e diz baixinho: "Tunde. I need to tell you something."

5-10s: close-up em Tunde. Ele para de mastigar. O olhar fica imóvel. Slow push-in no rosto dele enquanto o pânico se instala por trás de uma expressão completamente congelada. Ele engole em seco. Não pisca.

10-15s: ele coloca o prato de lado com cuidado exagerado, vira-se totalmente para encará-la e diz, com falsa calma: "Okay. I'm listening." A perna dele não para de balançar. Corte para Amaka, sem pressa, ajustando o brinco.

15-20s: Amaka solta o ar e diz: "I used your card yesterday." Whip-cut para Tunde. O corpo inteiro dele desaba de alívio, a cabeça cai para trás, as mãos vão ao rosto, e ele ri: "Ahh! Amaka! You scared me! Is that all?"

20-25s: ele minimiza, pega o prato de novo, ainda rindo. Amaka o observa por um instante e então diz, sem emoção: "Four hundred and fifty thousand."

25-30s: Tunde congela no meio da mordida. Slow push-in no rosto dele quando o valor cai. Longo silêncio. Ventilador girando. Ele lentamente coloca o prato de volta na mesa, encara o vazio à frente e diz baixinho: "Bring back the first problem." Segurar em Amaka tentando não rir. Corte para preto.

CÂMERA: plano médio vertical em dois personagens no sofá, slow push-ins no rosto de Tunde nos dois momentos de pânico, whip-cut para o alívio dele, hold estático na fala final.

ÁUDIO: ambiência da noite, ventilador de pé girando, tráfego distante e um gerador ao longe do lado de fora, talheres no prato, interpretação natural de conversa com sotaque nigeriano e pausas reais. Silêncio absoluto nos dois momentos de congelamento. Sem música.

PROIBIDO: sem renderização fotorrealista, sem cabeças de desenho animado desproporcionalmente grandes, sem drift de design, sem legendas, sem música de fundo, sem texto legível ou logos, sem iluminação dura.

zh.content:
3D角色动画，绘画感的非写实渲染。  
自然比例的纤细身形，真实的头身比。  
皮肤采用强烈的次表面散射着色，柔和哑光质感，温暖的深棕肤色带自然光泽。头发以雕塑般的分层体块建模，并带有温暖的轮廓光。漫射的朦胧主光，大光圈，浅景深，强烈 bloom。低饱和暖色调：赭石、陶土色、灰粉色、奶油色。柔和的低对比度调色。NOT photorealistic, NOT live action. 竖屏 9:16 构图，人物面部在画面中占比很大。

CHARACTERS（locked, no drift）:
TUNDE — 尼日利亚男性，30岁出头，短发，小胡子，图案短袖衬衫。表情丰富，默默惊慌，完全藏不住脸上的情绪。
AMAKA — 尼日利亚女性，20多岁末，长辫子向后扎起，金色圆环耳环，修身上衣和 wrapper。冷静、直接，甚至有点享受他的痛苦。

LOCATION: 傍晚时分的拉各斯公寓客厅。旧沙发、小茶几上放着一碗橙子、百叶窗透进柔和的琥珀色光线、一台缓慢转动的落地风扇、一只挂钟。

COLOR 60:30:10 — 60% 温暖琥珀色的墙面和木质 / 30% 灰粉色阴影 / 10% 橙子和金色耳环的点缀。

0-5s: 紧凑的竖屏中景。Tunde 坐在沙发上吃东西，神情放松。Amaka 进来，慢慢在他旁边坐下，双手交叠，轻声说：“Tunde. I need to tell you something.”

5-10s: Tunde 特写。他停止咀嚼，眼神凝住。镜头缓慢推近他的脸，惊慌在完全僵住的表情后面逐渐浮现。他吞咽了一下。没有眨眼。

10-15s: 他极其小心地把盘子放下，转身正对着她，故作镇定地说：“Okay. I'm listening.” 他的腿在抖。切到 Amaka，她不慌不忙，整理了一下耳环。

15-20s: Amaka 呼出一口气，说：“I used your card yesterday.” 快切到 Tunde。他整个人如释重负般瘫软下来，头向后仰，双手捂脸，笑着说：“Ahh! Amaka! You scared me! Is that all?”

20-25s: 他摆摆手，重新拿起盘子，仍在笑。Amaka 看了他一会儿，然后平静地说：“Four hundred and fifty thousand.”

25-30s: Tunde 咬到一半僵住。镜头缓慢推近他的脸，那个数字落下。长时间沉默。风扇转动。他慢慢又把盘子放下，直视前方，轻声说：“Bring back the first problem.” 停在 Amaka 强忍笑意的画面。切黑。

CAMERA: 沙发上的竖屏中景双人镜头，Tunde 两次惊慌时都对他的脸做缓慢推近，释然时快切，最后一句静止停留。

AUDIO: 傍晚环境音、落地风扇转动声、窗外隐约的交通声和远处发电机声、盘子上的餐具声，带有真实停顿的自然尼日利亚口音对话。两次僵住时完全静音。无音乐。

FORBIDDEN: no photorealistic rendering, no oversized cartoon heads, no design drift, no subtitles, no background music, no readable text or logos, no harsh lighting.
